title: Flow of hot water to fixtures.
officialText:
Fixture fittings, faucets and diverters shall be installed and adjusted so that the flow of hot water
from the fittings corresponds to the left-hand side of the fixture fitting.
Exception: Shower and tub/shower mixing valves conforming to ASSE 1016 or ASME A112.18.1/CSA B125.1, where the flow
of hot water corresponds to the markings on the device.
SECTION PC 608
PROTECTION OF POTABLE WATER SUPPLY
